scope: Read-only graphic/grid normalization proposal, not a memory qualification or part selection
acceptance_constraints: Preserve all 90 unique pin numbers, names, electrical types, shapes, lengths, directions and visibility.
Keep supply balls individually represented; never stack or coalesce same-net pins.
Update external library and every cached copy identically; verify the actual source hash before applying.
Move both endpoints of each of the 85 horizontal stubs and its global label/properties by the explicit world delta; preserve UUIDs and label names.
Move all five NC markers to the new pin endpoints, preserving their UUIDs.
Leave instantiated U3 Value, MPN, LCSC, Datasheet and footprint unchanged; RAM remains unqualified.
Use a neutral graphic symbol identity and remove unsupported drop-in wording; pin-map agreement does not establish electrical qualification.
Native netlist must retain all 90 U3 pin-net functions and all other component connections in the complete project.
The 86 U3 off-grid ERC records should disappear; introduce no new ERC errors/warnings and keep library/cache definitions identical.
Review the rendered page and confirm no physical PCB or firmware edits.
